# ProDOS boot source

`ProDOS_2_4_3.po` is the official release image, unchanged.

- Release: https://prodos8.com/releases/prodos-243
- Download: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProDOS-8/ProDOS8-Releases/master/ProDOS_2_4_3.po
- Published checksums: https://github.com/ProDOS-8/ProDOS8-Releases/blob/master/SHA256SUM
- SHA-256: `398d333cb2ab92df9f8bb2cf64b946f2567116910eb8359cf4bdee5d4194f0fa`

The builder extracts only the original boot blocks and `PRODOS` kernel
into the game disk. The original notices remain in the binary. The original
distribution disk is retained here for reproducible offline builds.
